title: Generative AI & Chatbot | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: Generative AI & Chatbot. Category: Development. Duration: 6 months. Description: Covers JavaScript, Express.js, Node.js, Dialogflow V2, React, Alexa Apps, and MongoDB. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city.
